# Swap decorator order: call_highest_priority must be outermost so that
# _sympifyit inspects the original function (whose 2nd arg is 'g'/'n').
import re
pattern = re.compile(
    r"    @_sympifyit\('(g|n)', NotImplemented\)\n"
    r"    @call_highest_priority\('(__\w+__)'\)\n")

def swap(m):
    return ("    @call_highest_priority('%s')\n"
            "    @_sympifyit('%s', NotImplemented)\n") % (m.group(2), m.group(1))

src, n = pattern.subn(swap, src)
print("swapped:", n)

with open(path, 'w') as f:
    f.write(src)
